subject: Emberbridge: request for combined trial credits + discount (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@emberbridge.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Trial expansion ask — combined credits + discount

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Emberbridge was really impressed with the latency profile and embeddings for our near-real-time search use case. We are ready to move from a week-long eval to a 6-week POC, but procurement needs a commercial sweetener to push the internal review forward.

Specifically, can Redwood offer:
- $25k worth of usage credits applied to the POC (to be consumed over 6 weeks)
- a one-time 15% list discount on the first 6 months if we move to a committed plan after POC

We have budget sign-off conditional on both items together — they view the credits as a way to de-risk technical integration and the discount as an incentive to convert.

Attached is our SOW draft (for scope). Happy to sync with whoever owns credits/discount approvals — Aaron (cc) will coordinate procurement.

Best,
Sophie Kramer
Head of Core AI, Emberbridge
Attachments: Emberbridge_Request_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@emberbridge.io>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@emberbridge.io>
Date: 2028-11-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expansion ask — combined credits + discount

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I can get you the credit schedule, but the 15% commercial discount requires an exec OK because it’s outside our standard promo bands. Looping in Marissa and Mina to request a one-off approval.

Tentative implementation plan if approved:
- Apply $25k promotional credits to the Emberbridge trial account (valid during the 6-week POC).
- If Emberbridge signs a 6-month commit within 30 days after POC, apply a 15% discount to list rates for the first 6 months.
- Standard T&Cs apply (no stacking with other offers).

I’m sharing the SOW + proposed credit schedule in the next internal note.

Cheers,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Emberbridge POC ask — need exec concession approval

Marissa / Mina — forwarding the customer request. TL;DR: Emberbridge is requesting $25k in trial credits + a 15% one-time discount on the first 6 months if they commit after the POC. They are a mid-sized marketplace with clear near-term potential; leadership flagged them as a strategic reference for our search/embeddings story.

Why I’m asking for approval:
- Credits: $25k to be applied over a 6-week POC (expected to offset initial heavy token usage during integration).
- Discount: 15% one-time on monthlies for first 6 months, conditional on 6-month commit signed within 30 days after POC.

Business impact:
- ACV uplift expected if they convert: ~$120k ARR (conservative).
- Reference value: good fit for our enterprise search case studies.

Attachments (for review):
- Proposed_Credit_Schedule_Emberbridge.xlsx (shows estimated token burn and timing)
- Emberbridge_Request_SOW_v1.pdf

Request: can we approve the combined concession as an exception? If so I’ll send them an official confirmation and update HubSpot.

Thanks — Marcus

> On Nov 1, 2028, Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@emberbridge.io> wrote:
> > (see original request and SOW attached)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Emberbridge POC ask — need exec concession approval

Thanks for the summary Marcus. I ran the numbers with Finance and pulled the projected token curve from the credit schedule. A few notes:

- $25k credits cover the estimated POC usage with ~10% buffer.
- The 15% discount on the first 6 months would reduce near-term ARR by roughly $18k YoY versus list (assuming conservative convert and usage).
- Risk: if they consume the credits and churn, we bear the usage cost; recommend a smaller credit or split (e.g., $15k credits + milestone-based $10k top-up) if we want to insulate.

Options I suggest for approval language (pick one):
1) Full ask: $25k credits + 15% one-time discount on 6 months (exec signoff required).
2) Split credits: $15k upfront + $10k tied to successful milestone (first integration demo), 15% discount.
3) Reduced discount: $25k credits + 10% discount for 6 months.

If you can share anticipated conversion timeline and a short win plan, I’ll model the net expected value and provide recommendation for Marissa’s signoff.

—Mina
Director, Revenue Operations
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: Proposed_Credit_Schedule_Emberbridge.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-10T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Emberbridge POC ask — need exec concession approval

Marissa — quick finance view. I prefer option 2 from Mina: split credits with milestone triggers. That reduces downside while keeping the commercial signal strong. Suggested language for approval:

- Apply $15,000 promotional credits on Day 1 of the POC.
- Hold $10,000 of credits to be applied upon successful completion of integration demo (within 30 days of POC start).
- Offer a 12% one-time discount (instead of 15%) on the first 6 months if Emberbridge signs a 6-month committed contract within 30 days after POC.
- Credits expire at end of POC; discount applies only to the first invoice period following conversion.

If this gets Marissa’s OK I’ll prepare a simple concession letter and charge impact note.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance — Revenue
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Emberbridge concession (finalized terms)

Thanks team — I reviewed the options and approve Naomi’s compromise. Final concession to communicate to Emberbridge:

- $15,000 credits active at POC start + $10,000 credits released upon successful integration demo (milestone)
- 12% one-time discount on the first 6 months if they sign a 6-month committed contract within 30 days of POC completion
- All credits expire at POC end; discount applies only once and is not combinable with other offers

Marcus: please get written acknowledgement from the customer on the milestone definition and have Legal review the short concession letter (I’ll greenlight the sign-off once Legal confirms language).

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Sales
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Sophie — good news: executive sign-off confirmed. Below are the agreed, final terms for the POC concession: 

1) Trial credits
- $15,000 promotional credits applied immediately at POC start.
- $10,000 of credits reserved and applied upon successful integration demo (milestone to be completed within 30 days of POC start).
2) Discount on conversion
- One-time 12% discount on list rates applied to the first 6 months if Emberbridge signs a 6-month committed contract within 30 days after POC completion.
3) Other
- Credits expire at the end of the POC period. Discount is one-time and cannot be combined with other promos.

Next steps: 
- Can you confirm the name(s) of the technical owner(s) for the integration demo and aim for a milestone window (we recommend week 2 or 3)?
- I’ll route the concession letter to Legal and loop you once signed.

I’ve attached the credit schedule and SOW for reference. Once you confirm milestone owner, we’ll schedule the kickoff.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.
